title: World Cup Daily live: Spidercam debate rumbles on as four semifinalists confirmed - ESPN
text:
The semifinal lineup is set: the winners of France vs. Spain and England vs. Argentina will battle it out for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

Although there are no matches over the next two days, there will be no shortage of storylines as the four remaining teams prepare for the biggest games of the tournament and the debate over the Spidercam impacting play during England vs. Norway is one of them!

Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the competition.
